observations: Multiple white Intermediate Bulk Containers (IBCs) stacked outdoors on wooden pallets.
The containers feature a metal cage frame and a plastic liner.
Visible rust and corrosion on the wooden pallets supporting the containers.
No manufacturer logos, capacity markings, or material specifications are legible on the plastic bodies.
Watermark 'PASTECH GLOBAL TECHNICAL' appears across all photos.

claims.evidence: No capacity markings are visible in the photos.
No food-grade certification or markings are visible.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Actual capacity may be different from 1,000 litres.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity marking stamped into the plastic or metal frame.

risks.risk: The plastic liner may be thin, damaged, or non-food-grade.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plastic liner showing its thickness and any wear.

risks.risk: The metal cage may be rusted or structurally compromised.
risks.proof: A video showing the cage being shaken or a close-up of the welds.

risks.risk: The plastic may be degraded or brittle from UV exposure.
risks.proof: A photo of the plastic showing surface cracks or discoloration.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the capacity marking (e.g., 1000L) on the container.
Photo of the plastic liner showing its thickness and condition.
Photo of the metal cage showing the welds and rust condition.
Photo of the lids to confirm they are present and in good condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
